# Arcarius Digital

> Fixed-price websites for Brunei businesses - mini mart, garage, salon, tuition centres, F&B/food businesses, grocery stores, and retail stores. WhatsApp-first, no monthly fees.

## Pricing

- Starter (B$388, one-time): mobile-first website plus a free Google Business Profile fix.
- Complete (B$688, one-time, most popular): everything in Starter plus one manual process fixed - a booking page or an order page.
- Complete Plus (B$1,288, one-time): everything in Complete plus both a booking page and an order page, plus a priority build slot.
- Makeover (B$48/hour): redesign of a website the business already has, quoted in estimated hours after a look at the site.

## Key facts

- Typical build timeline: 2-5 business days, depending on the request.
- Payment: 50% deposit before work begins, 50% due on delivery. No monthly fees or subscriptions on any option.
- Government support: Brunei has support programmes for local businesses (for example through Darussalam Enterprise). Eligibility changes and a website build is not guaranteed to qualify.
- Languages: the site is available in English and Bahasa Melayu.
- Contact: WhatsApp +60 16-426 1472, email arcariusdigital@gmail.com
